abstract: We report on a 15-year-old female with left ovarian dysgerminoma accompanied by massive swelling of the para-aortic lymph nodes which was clearly demonstrated by preoperative magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Metastasis to the para-aortic lymph nodes from dysgerminoma was confirmed by biopsies obtained during surgery. No study has previously reported dysgerminoma with massive para-aortic lymph node metastases clearly demonstrated by MRI. These preoperative MRI findings are presented here. The patient received six cycles of cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy with the BEP regimen (bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin) after conservative surgery, and no residual para-aortic lymph nodes were detected by MRI or CT after the chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 15歳女性の左卵巣未分化胚細胞腫に、傍大動脈リンパ節の著明な腫大を伴う症例を報告する。術前の磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で傍大動脈リンパ節の著明な腫大が明瞭に描出され、手術時の生検により未分化胚細胞腫からの転移が確認された。これまで、未分化胚細胞腫による傍大動脈リンパ節への大量転移をMRIで明瞭に示した報告はない。本症例の術前MRI所見を示す。患者は温存手術後、ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンからなるBEP療法を6サイクル受けた。化学療法後、MRIおよびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で残存する傍大動脈リンパ節は認められなかった。
